title: Bridge Base Online Board Score Leaderboard
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bridgebase:board score_points=*
| stats sum(score_points) as total_value, avg(score_points) as avg_value by partnership_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks partnership name values by total and average score across Bridge Base Online board events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `score_points` values for each Bridge Base Online board event and review total and average score by partnership name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total score.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which partnership name shows the biggest score numbers in your Bridge Base Online board data.
